subject: Confirmed churner and tenure definitions
body: Hi Sofia, confirming our discussion: recent churners are consumers who left ConnectTel within the previous six months. For current customers, we can provide tenure bands of under 12 months, 12-35 months, 36-59 months, and 60 months or more. Please use those bands in the sample-monitoring and analysis plan. This is a clarification within the existing scope; it does not change the total sample or markets. Thanks, Maya
